steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const f=g.fishing; f.fight={fish:{species:'king',weight:14.5,legend:null}}; f.finishCatch(); return 'card up: '+!document.getElementById('catch').hidden+', small map hidden: '+(getComputedStyle(document.getElementById('minimap')).visibility==='hidden')})()

(()=>{const card=document.getElementById('catch'); const a=card.getAnimations().length; __rhf.game.hud.measureCatch(); const b=card.getAnimations().length; return (b>a?'FAIL':'PASS')+' measuring again leaves the card still: animations running '+a+' before, '+b+' after'})()

(()=>{const s=document.documentElement.style;s.setProperty('--sat','0px');s.setProperty('--sar','59px');s.setProperty('--sab','21px');s.setProperty('--sal','59px');__rhf.game.hud.measureCatch(); return 'safe area sat 0px sar 59px sab 21px sal 59px'})()
(()=>{const s=document.documentElement.style; for (const k of ['--sat','--sar','--sab','--sal']) s.removeProperty(k); __rhf.game.hud.measureCatch(); return 'safe area as the browser gives it'})()
